summary: Reserves the Extended Master Session Key (EMSK) from EAP for the sole purpose of deriving root keys. Root keys are master keys that can be used for several purposes identified by usage definitions. The memo also specifies a way to avoid conflicts between root keys by deriving them in a way tied to their intended use.

eli5.summary: One master key can be used to make many separate keys, each only for one job, like a master recipe that yields different dishes without mixing them up.
